function: Excluded (system): co-phase analog and digital over-the-air aggregation for federated learning (area 7), but over single-antenna links without RIS; scalar channel coefficient per user and AP, p. 3 Eq. (5)-(6).
notes: Excluded for system (code 6); codes 1 to 5 do not apply: research article, a linear SVC is trained across devices over the air (p. 8), the problem is physical-layer aggregation (p. 2, contributions i to iii), and quantitative results are reported (pp. 8 to 11). Area would be 7. The link is single-antenna with no RIS: p. 3 Eq. (5) gives one scalar Rayleigh channel coefficient h_{u;s}(t) per user and AP, and Eq. (6) is a scalar-weighted sum of the gradient sequences x_{u,s}(t), real vectors of length L sent over L channel uses. p. 2: "Each user and server own independent transceiver antennas" gives no antenna count, Fig. 1 on p. 2 shows each user and server as one device icon, Table I lists no antenna dimension, and no array, beamformer or RIS appears anywhere. The paper never writes 'single antenna', so the decision rests on the scalar model. If the reviewer reads the system as multi-antenna, the marks would be q1 0 (p. 3: "symmetric Rayleigh fading", a custom model), q2 0 (each setting is trained afresh, Figs. 4 to 9), q3 0 (only AOTA-MS against DOTA-MSRT, both defined by the paper, p. 8), q4 0 (only the uplink bandwidth reduction of p. 4 Eq. 17, no computational cost), q5 0 (CIFAR-10 task data only, p. 8, no code).
